name: Consensus Capital
tagline: Links prediction-market probabilities to your stock portfolio so you see event risk.

awards: Best AI project that uses the Gumloop API

problem: Traders watch charts and earnings but miss probabilistic signals from prediction markets.
solution: Ingests the most active prediction markets and maps their probabilities to the assets in a portfolio.
demo_moment: Team-described: open your portfolio and see which events it is exposed to.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best AI project that uses the Gumloop API” and “Best Use of Auth0” among 127 submissions.
Connects two data worlds traders keep separate.

lessons: Bridging two familiar data sources can be novel enough.
